sentences.en: I get goose bumps when I see a horror movie.
sentences.zh: 看到恐怖电影时我会起鸡皮疙瘩。

sentences.en: One regularly bumps into more beautiful women in the street.
sentences.zh: 街上经常能遇到更多美女。

sentences.en: The waiters bumped into each other and dropped their trays.
sentences.zh: 服务员们撞到了一起，把盘子都掉了下来。
